valuation.method: Forward EPS x justified P/E. FY2027 diluted EPS (fiscal year ending about 31 Oct 2027), the period an investor at the Nov 2027 target date prices, multiplied by a P/E. USD listing, NYSE common stock, no FX conversion needed. Anchors: FY2026 net income guidance $4.75-5.00B (raised low end, Q3 release 20 Aug 2026) on about 269.6M shares, which is roughly $17.6-18.5 per share; Q3 FY2026 EPS $5.10 on net income $1.379B and net sales $12.61B; management says 2026 marks the bottom of the current ag equipment cycle. Share count 269,625,412 used for the market cap bounds. Dividend $6.48 annual rate per the aggregate row.

bear.driver: Ag cycle trough extends into FY2027; North American large-equipment sales fall further (guided down 15-20% in FY2026 outlook) and South America and Europe stay weak
bear.assumption: EPS $18.00 (flat to FY2026 trough) x 18x mid-cycle P/E

base.driver: Gradual recovery from the FY2026 trough with tariff refunds not repeated; consensus FY2027 EPS of about $22.19 trimmed toward JPMorgan's $20.49 cut

bull.driver: Faster replacement and precision-ag recovery plus buybacks (about $20B 2027 program cited in coverage); Baird's about $25 FY2027 EPS view

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $22.00 the close of $673.54 implies 30.6x FY2027 EPS. The aggregate analyst mean of $694.01 (median $728) implies about 28-31x on base EPS, or about $28.70 EPS at 24x, roughly 30% above base EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $22.00 (3.3 pp of the $673.54 close). A $1.00 change in FY2027 EPS moves the base target by $24.00 (3.6 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: North American large-equipment order and production trend and FY2027 net income guidance; a clear FY2027 EPS step-up toward $25 supports the bull case, while a further cut toward $20 supports the bear case
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year FY2026 earnings release scheduled 2026-11-25 (08:30 ET per the aggregate row), which includes FY2027 outlook commentary

analyst_notes: Named coverage found for this window is thin: Baird (Mircea Dobre) raised its target to $800 from $640 with an Outperform rating on 31 Aug 2026 and cites about $25 FY2027 EPS, while Jefferies moved to Hold with a $550 target (dated 8 Apr 2026 from a 'Wednesday' reference) and DA Davidson's $685 target on 22 May 2026 is a cut with an unknown prior. JPMorgan (Tami Zakaria, Hold) cut FY2027 EPS to $20.49 from $22.81 after Q3, which is the main gap to our base EPS of $22.00 (about 10% lower EPS would take the target to about $475 at 24x). The aggregate mean of $694 is above the close, but it is a broad provider aggregate of 23 analysts (not used in the weighted calculation) and is not reconciled to dated named calls. Several post-Q3 target moves reported by aggregators (Oppenheimer, Citi, Evercore) lacked verifiable dates and are excluded.
